name: Firecrawl
one_liner: Web search, scrape, interact and crawl API that returns LLM-ready markdown or structured data for AI agents.
auth_notes: Bearer API key in Authorization header. /v2/scrape, /v2/search and /v2/parse work keylessly with limits. OAuth for apps lets users connect their own Firecrawl account.
access_notes: Free plan: 1,000 credits/month, no card required, self-serve key. Paid: Hobby $19/mo monthly or $16/mo annual; Standard $99/$83; Growth $399/$333; Scale $749/$599. No wait or approval stated.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free key, documented REST API with bearer auth, official SDKs and MCP server. Free tier rate limits are low but not a gate. Scrape, search, map, crawl, interact and agent are all documented.

access.quote: Sign up for a free API key to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost

api_surface.quote: Rate limits are measured in requests per minute

webhooks.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes.

mcp.quote: The hosted Firecrawl MCP keyless endpoint exposes exactly Search, Scrape, and Parse without an API key.

disputes.why: llms.txt lists v2 and webhooks OpenAPI specs.
